versions.title: Initial release
items: Organizations, members, and role-based permissions
Customers and customer portal for ticket collaboration
Projects, tasks, subtasks, tags, and Kanban boards
Tickets with SLA rules and attachments
Resource planning Gantt with allocations and calendars
Time tracking, active timers, and call records
Dashboard KPIs, portfolio, work summary, and reporting hub
Applications and releases with PDF export
Integrations for Jira, GitHub, Gitea, Outlook, and email queue
Optional Redis cache, API tokens, and IDE Kanban extensions

versions.title: Organization analytics
items: Update Portuguese translations for consistency in the i18n locale files, correcting the term for "sprints" from "Corridas" to "Sprints"

Implement organization detail analytics component and enhance reporting page with new metrics and visualizations. Introduce multi-series charting for tasks by status, user, and type, and update UI elements for improved user experience

Refactor i18n handling by removing unused imports and functions, and implement a new server-side loading mechanism for locale literals. Update the I18nProvider to utilize the new loading method and streamline locale management across components
Remove unused i18n imports and related functions from various components and pages to streamline code and improve maintainability

versions.title: Runtime locales and proxy support
items: Enhance Dockerfile to include runtime locale files and improve error handling for missing locale files in the server-side loading mechanism. Implement trust proxy settings in the server configuration for better handling of client IPs behind Docker and reverse proxies

versions.title: Container health checks
items: Implement liveness check endpoint and update health check logic in Docker configuration. Update version to 1.1.3 in package.json and enhance Portuguese translations for consistency

versions.title: Manual and ops polish
items: Add Myelin manual and navigation documentation, including sections on user roles, first login, global search, and email preferences. Update .gitignore to include generated documentation ZIP file
Update Docker configuration to use dynamic port for health check, ensuring alignment with runtime PORT environment variable. Enhance README to clarify health check behavior and internal port usage
Refine Portuguese translations in i18n files for improved clarity and consistency, updating terms for "organization switcher" and "out of office"

versions.title: Remote MCP, agent docs, and What's New
items: Bump version to 1.2.0 and update changelog with new features and enhancements, including settings tab integration, improved navigation, and enhanced session management

Implement settings tab in application and organization detail views, allowing users to edit application and organization details directly within the UI. Enhance navigation by adding settings to the existing tab structure

Enhance application UI by integrating Agent Docs panel and PageTabs for improved navigation in organization and application detail views. Update .gitignore to exclude cursor configuration files. Add MCP preferences management in user profile settings. Add MCP server to read, update and create tasks in Myelin

Implement "What's New" feature to display changelog entries in the dashboard and app chrome tools. Add API endpoints for fetching changelog data and marking versions as seen. Update Dockerfile to include changelog documentation and enhance localization for new UI elements

versions.title: Implement new sprint management features, including the ability to li…
items: Implement new sprint management features, including the ability to list sprints with associated tasks, retrieve individual sprint details, and update sprint information. Enhance task management by allowing optional sprint assignments and including sprint details in task responses. Update documentation to reflect these changes

Standardize HTTP method usage across various components by replacing localized 'post' translations with the explicit 'POST' method. This change ensures consistency in API requests throughout the application
